name: Major cyber incidents
value: France blames IRGC for destructive fridge hacks
summary: France on 9 Nov blamed an IRGC unit for attacks on refrigeration in about 700 stores that caused at least 15 fires
state: On 9 Nov France's cyber crisis centre attributed the 11–12 Oct attacks on refrigeration controllers in about 700 grocery stores to Shahid Kaveh, an IRGC cyber unit; at least 15 fires and tens of millions of euros of food losses followed (The Record; BleepingComputer). A later wave from 2 Nov hit stores in other European countries and French blood bank cold storage, with no blood products lost (Khaleej Times, Reuters). A destructive state-attributed attack sets the Alert.
for_you: Follow NCSC guidance. Businesses using remotely managed building or refrigeration controls should check NCSC and vendor advisories.
rubric_hit: Destructive state-attributed attack (France attributes fridge attacks to IRGC, 9 Nov) = Alert

why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
